subject: SIG completion — final confirmation, risk note and cutover plan
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally.park@lumentech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@lumentech.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 18, 2027 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: SIG v5 & procurement deadline — need clarification by Feb 22

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement has a hard cut: SIG questionnaire completed and evidence uploaded by end of day Feb 22 PST in order to keep our Q1 procurement window. There are a few open items on the SIG v5 spreadsheet (attached) we need clarified:

- Question 3.2 (network segmentation) — we need the current diagram or a clear statement of controls.
- Question 5.1 (encryption in transit) — please confirm TLS versions in use + any exceptions.
- Evidence mapping for SOC 2 controls; procurement expects a short SOC 2 summary doc.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver the items above by Feb 20 EOD PST so we have time to review before our 22nd deadline? If Feb 20 isn't possible, we need escalation now so procurement can hold the timeline.

Also, could we have a short 30–45 min review call on Feb 20 afternoon (your availability)?

Attached: SIG-v5.xlsx (worksheet from procurement).

Best,
Sally Park
Senior IT Procurement Manager
LumenTech Inc.
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Park <sally.park@lumentech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Feb 18, 2027 at 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: SIG v5 & procurement deadline — need clarification by Feb 22

Hi Sally — thanks for the clear list. We can commit to the following plan:

- By Feb 19 EOD PST: deliver a draft of the SIG answers for your review (most questions completed).
- By Feb 20 EOD PST: deliver final SIG v5 spreadsheet with attachments (network diagram, SOC 2 summary, and TLS statement).

Action owners: Marcus will provide the network diagram (diego will validate), Monica will assemble SOC 2 evidence summary, Aditya will produce the TLS/crypto statement and map artifacts to SIG questions.

We can do a 45-minute review call Feb 20 at 3:30 PM PST — does that work for you?

I attached our working draft (SIG-v5.xlsx) so you can see in-line comments. If procurement needs anything notarized or additional pointer docs, let me know and we'll prioritize.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Strategic Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mailto:grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Attachment: SIG-v5.xlsx (draft)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Feb 19, 2027 at 2:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: SIG v5 — network diagram version and engineering window

Grace / Monica — quick internal note:

- Diego has the up-to-date network diagram (v3) but needs ~4 hours to scrub and remove sensitive hostnames; I'll ask him to export a redacted PDF (network-diagram.pdf).
- On question 3.2 we should include the segmentation table + a short narrative; Diego can provide both by EOD Feb 20 if we prioritize.
- Monica: where are you keeping SOC 2 artifacts? I need the control mapping doc link to reference in the SIG spreadsheet.

If procurement pushes earlier than Feb 20 I can escalate to infra SME and try to pull early, but prefer to keep Feb 20 final cutoff.

—Marcus
VP, Solutions Engineering
From: Sally Park <sally.park@lumentech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@lumentech.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 20, 2027 at 10:30 AM PST
Subject: Re: SIG v5 & procurement deadline — need clarification by Feb 22

Grace — appreciate the plan. Two quick notes from procurement: if we do not have final SIG + evidence by COB Feb 22, procurement will remove Redwood from this quarter's approved vendor list and push contracting to the next cycle (likely 2-week delay).

Also: Tom asked whether we can make the review call 3:30 PM PST on Feb 20 (instead of 45 min, he prefers 60 to walk legal and procurement through items). Can you make 3:30–4:30 PM PST?

Attachment: lumentech-procurement-timeline.pdf

Regards,
Sally
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Park <sally.park@lumentech.com>, LumenTech Procurement <procurement@lumentech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@lumentech.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 20, 2027 at 4:45 PM PST
Subject: Final SIG v5 submission + cutover plan and risks (deliverables attached)

Sally / Tom / Procurement team —

Thank you for the clarity on the timeline. Per our commitments, please find attached the completed artifacts for SIG v5:

- SIG-v5.xlsx — completed answers, redlines resolved, evidence mapping in column F.
- network-diagram.pdf — redacted topology diagram (Diego, Marcus).
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — short SOC 2 control mapping and auditor statement (Monica).

Key confirmations:
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ for external endpoints, TLS 1.3 preferred internally; Aditya included the exception list in the spreadsheet (row 142).
- Data retention: Our standard retention policy and deletion cadence are summarized in the SOC 2 doc and mapped to SIG question 7.

Cutover/acceptance plan:
1) You review attachments and SIG spreadsheet tonight (Feb 20).
2) We host a 60-minute walkthrough Feb 20, 3:30–4:30 PM PST to address legal/procurement questions (calendar invite sent).
3) If no further clarifications are requested, we consider SIG complete and procurement can proceed to contracting. If procurement requests additional evidence after your review, we will respond with prioritized deadlines and expected delivery windows (typical turnaround 1–3 business days).

Risk note (please escalate internally if needed): If final SIG is not accepted by COB Feb 22, procurement will pause onboarding which would likely shift contracting to the next procurement window (estimated 2-week delay). If LumenTech needs faster turnaround for any exception items, please escalate to Tom and we'll push additional engineering hours.

Next steps / action items:
- Procurement/Sally: confirm receipt of attachments and tell us if any items require immediate escalation.
- Tom (procurement): advise whether you need any notarized evidence or signatures.
- LumenTech legal: notify us before 10 AM PST Feb 21 if there are high-priority legal clarifications so we can triage.

Thanks — we value the partnership and want to make sure this is smooth.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Strategic Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: SIG-v5.xlsx, network-diagram.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
